title: Prevent Distraction with Price Pacts
coreMove: Attach a meaningful cost to a clearly defined distraction only after the desired path is already planned and possible.
sourcePressure: The chapter treats price pacts as one subtype of pact, attaching explicit consequence before the weak moment so distraction stops feeling cheap.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would make money penalties sound like a gimmick and skip the order of operations.

hook: Prevent Distraction with Price Pacts as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: freelance cartographer finishing a trail map revision
exampleSpecs.audience: cartographer who repeatedly opens travel forums during map work
exampleSpecs.stakes: client delivery and trail safety depend on precise revisions
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: after setting the revision block, she pledges a donation if travel forums open before the contour layer is done
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A contour-layer proof sits beside a pledge receipt.

exampleSpecs.domain: rowing-club mechanic rebuilding an oarlock rack
exampleSpecs.audience: mechanic who keeps watching race clips between repairs
exampleSpecs.stakes: boats miss practice if repairs stretch
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he places twenty dollars in the junior-team jar if clips open before six oarlocks are bolted
exampleSpecs.firstImage: An oarlock bolt tray rests beside a junior-team jar.

exampleSpecs.audience: lawyer who has planned the block but checks commentary sites
exampleSpecs.stakes: filing precision needs the whole morning
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she sends a pact to a colleague: if commentary opens before section two is drafted, lunch is on her
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A filing outline sits beside a lunch-pact note.

exampleSpecs.audience: repairer who drifts into auction listings
exampleSpecs.stakes: a player's instrument must be ready by evening
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, listings feel free; after, every premature auction click funds the youth ensemble jar
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A clarinet pad tray lies under a youth ensemble envelope.

exampleSpecs.domain: boutique hotel night auditor closing accounts
exampleSpecs.audience: auditor who opens sports feeds after midnight
exampleSpecs.stakes: morning accounts fail if late drift stays costless
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he sets a pact that any feed before closeout buys breakfast for the day clerk
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A closeout tape curls beside a breakfast voucher.

exampleSpecs.domain: language tutor creating lesson audio files
exampleSpecs.audience: tutor who checks messages during export waits
exampleSpecs.stakes: students receive late files when the waits become escapes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she makes a cost pact only after batching exports and placing a checklist beside the audio folder
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A waveform export panel sits beside a lesson-audio checklist.
